policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Panama stamped consular visa
policies.summary: Panama's current National Migration Service decree index expressly places India in the stamped-visa-by-consul cohort. The ordinary short-visitor baseline is therefore an advance consular visa, not an electronic or arrival-issued visa.
conditions: This records the ordinary short-visitor baseline without a separate conditional waiver based on a valid third-country visa or residence document.
It does not determine admission, transit, employment, residence, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, or special-document treatment.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Kyrgyz Republic Tourist eVisa
policies.summary: The live Kyrgyz MFA eVisa selector exposes Tourist (TS) after India is selected for the ordinary-passport application flow. The official portal says approval is an electronic visa confirmation received before entry, so this is an eVisa.
conditions: The ordinary short-visitor route is Tourist (TS), up to 30 days according to the official portal's visa-category information.
The traveller must complete the online application and receive electronic confirmation before entering; individual eligibility and border admission remain subject to the issuing authority.
This does not model the separate facilitated one-month route for qualifying Gulf resident-card holders or diplomatic/service treatment.

application.label: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa application
steps: Select India, Ordinary passport, and Tourist (TS).
Complete the online eVisa application and wait for electronic confirmation before travel.
